description: In the autumn of 2026, a coalition of EU member states, alarmed by the US restriction of access to frontier models and the vulnerability exposed by the cyber_test_shot, quietly begins coordinating with Japan, South Korea, and Taiwan to establish shared evaluation protocols and mutual access guarantees for advanced AI systems. The initiative is framed as a resilience-building measure, but its real purpose is to create a counterweight to unilateral US control over AI capability. It gains traction because ASML’s strategic position gives the EU leverage in semiconductor diplomacy.
